scenes.imagePrompt: Medium-wide shot at the foot of the marble staircase as MARA and DAMIAN arrive arm in arm, guests parting and turning, photographers' flashes bursting; MARA's chin lifted, a flicker of nerves beneath her poise; DAMIAN's hand at the small of her back. Chandeliers blazing above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow tracking shot as Mara and Damian step forward together, flashes popping, guests parting and whispering. Damian leans to her ear: 'Smile, Mrs. Cross. Everyone's watching.' Mara, through a perfect smile: 'Let them.' Her shoulders settle as she walks.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium shot at the edge of the dance floor: CELESTE tilting her wrist so red wine splashes across MARA's emerald bodice, MARA's lips parted in a controlled gasp, CELESTE's face a mask of fake horror; the red streak vivid against green satin. DAMIAN blurred in the background, turning.
scenes.videoPrompt: Celeste steps toward Mara with a syrupy smile, her wrist accidentally tipping the glass; red wine splashes down the emerald gown. Celeste, faking sweetness: 'Oops. Clumsy me.' Mara, calm and low, takes the empty glass from her fingers: 'You've already taken enough from me.' She sets it on a passing tray.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium close-up: DAMIAN shrugging off his black tuxedo jacket and settling it over MARA's shoulders, covering the stain; MARA looking up at him, surprised and quietly moved; CELESTE behind them, smile frozen, glass empty.
scenes.videoPrompt: Damian slips off his tuxedo jacket and drapes it over Mara's shoulders. Loud enough for the room: 'My wife looks perfect in anything.' Whispers ripple through the crowd. Mara looks up at him, startled by the warmth; behind her, Celeste's smile cracks.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium two-shot at the candlelit cocktail table: VIVIENNE rigid in black satin, eyes fixed across the room with cold alarm; JULIAN beside her, jaw tight, glancing uneasily at his mother; chandelier bokeh behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in. Julian, uneasy, watching across the room: 'Why would Cross marry an Ellison?' Vivienne, low, without turning her head: 'Because Thomas left something behind.' Her knuckles whiten around the champagne flute.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium shot: MARA alone at the moonlit terrace railing, DAMIAN's jacket around her shoulders, city lights glittering below, warm light spilling from the glass doors behind her. JULIAN's silhouette approaching in soft focus in the far background.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in on Mara at the railing, exhaling into the cold night. Footsteps behind her; Julian drifts into frame in soft focus. Julian, quiet: 'You look happy, Mara. It suits you.' Mara, not turning: 'Go back inside, Julian.'

scenes.imagePrompt: Close medium shot: JULIAN's hand clamped around MARA's wrist on the railing, her arm pulled taut; her face turned toward him with defiance and a flash of fear; his expression desperate and entitled.
scenes.videoPrompt: Julian seizes Mara's wrist as she turns to leave. Desperate: 'Whatever he's paying you, I'll double it.' Mara, cold and clear, looking down at his hand: 'You couldn't afford me.' She wrenches against his grip.

scenes.imagePrompt: Wide-medium shot: DAMIAN stepping out of the glass doors, one hand already closing over JULIAN's wrist and lifting it from MARA's arm, face calm but eyes lethal; JULIAN flinching; MARA in the middle, gasping.
scenes.videoPrompt: Damian crosses the terrace in two strides and closes his hand over Julian's, lifting it slowly from Mara's wrist. Softly, dangerously: 'Let go of my wife.' Julian winces and releases. Damian, still gripping: 'Touch her again and Vance & Sons won't survive the quarter.' Julian's arrogance falters.

scenes.imagePrompt: Tight three-way composition: JULIAN wrenching free of DAMIAN's grip and leaning toward MARA with a bitter, triumphant sneer; DAMIAN rigid at her side; MARA's eyes shifting from Julian to Damian, uncertainty blooming.
scenes.videoPrompt: Julian backs away rubbing his wrist and sneers at Mara: 'Ask your husband where he was the night your father died.' Damian's face goes still. Mara slowly turns to look at him, searching. Julian disappears through the glass doors. Hold on the silence.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium two-shot in the dim study at night: MARA at the desk, arms crossed tight, glaring, anger and grief in her eyes; DAMIAN at the window, back half-turned, jaw clenched; green lamp glow, city glitter.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in. Mara, shaking with restraint: 'Where were you the night my father died?' Damian keeps his back to her for a long moment, then turns, eyes red-rimmed: 'With him. I held his hand.' Mara's face crumples.

scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up on DAMIAN's face in the green lamp light, eyes distant with memory, rain-light flickering on the window glass behind him, raw vulnerability cracking his stillness.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in on Damian as he speaks, hollow with memory: 'It was raining. He said it wasn't an accident. Then he made me promise.' His throat works. Out of focus in the foreground, Mara's silhouette lifts a hand to her mouth.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium close-up: DAMIAN's hand placing a worn cream envelope with a small brass key taped to it into MARA's open palm, her silver band prominent; her face soft in the background, tears spilling.
scenes.videoPrompt: Damian sets a worn envelope with a small brass key taped to it in Mara's palm. Quietly: 'Your father gave me this. And the ring was your mother's.' Mara stares at the silver band on her finger, a sob catching in her throat.

scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up on MARA reading a handwritten letter under the green lamp, lips trembling, a tear falling onto the paper; the brass key glinting on the desk beside her hand; DAMIAN blurred at the frame's edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara unfolds the letter and reads in a broken whisper: 'The truth is under the heart of the shop.' She looks up at Damian, eyes blazing through tears: 'The oven.' Damian nods once: 'Tonight.'

scenes.imagePrompt: Wide shot of the brick-vaulted cellar: MARA and DAMIAN at the foot of the stairs in weak amber light, her flashlight beam sweeping across the massive brick oven and hanging copper pans, dust motes floating; DAMIAN alert at her shoulder.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld-style follow shot as Mara sweeps a flashlight beam across the cellar, dust motes drifting. She whispers: 'Dad always said the oven was the heart of the shop.' Damian, low: 'Then start there.' The beam settles on the blackened iron oven door.

scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up: MARA's hand pressing a soot-blackened loose brick behind the oven mouth; a narrow iron door half-revealed in the shadowed brick; DAMIAN's tense face over her shoulder, lit by the flashlight beam.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara presses a soot-blackened brick behind the oven mouth; it clicks and sinks inward, revealing a small iron door. She slides the brass key in and turns it; the lock gives with a heavy clunk. Damian exhales: 'He hid it well.'

scenes.imagePrompt: Over-the-shoulder shot into the hidden alcove: an open iron safe holding a leather-bound ledger, an old cassette recorder and a folded photograph; MARA's face lit from below by the flashlight, awe and grief; DAMIAN beside her.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara lifts out a leather ledger and an old cassette recorder, hands trembling. She opens the ledger and traces a column of figures: 'Every payment. Every name. He kept everything.' Damian, quiet, proud and pained: 'He kept it for you.'

scenes.imagePrompt: Tense medium shot: MARA clutching the ledger to her chest, she and DAMIAN frozen, eyes turned up toward the stairway; DAMIAN stepping in front of her protectively; the amber bulb overhead flickering.
scenes.videoPrompt: A floorboard creaks overhead; the shop bell rings faintly. The cellar bulb flickers and dies, leaving only Mara's shaking flashlight beam. Damian steps in front of her, whispering: 'Stay behind me.' Slow footsteps begin down the stairs.

episodes.title: You Told Me It Was an Accident

scenes.imagePrompt: Low-angle wide-medium shot from the cellar floor: VIVIENNE emerging from shadow at the foot of the stairs in her camel coat, silver bob immaculate, one black-gloved hand extended; JULIAN a step behind her, pale and rain-damp, eyes on the floor; the caged bulb swaying amber.
scenes.videoPrompt: The caged bulb sputters back to life. Vivienne steps out of the darkness at the foot of the stairs, Julian trailing behind her. Silky and calm: 'Hello, Mara. I believe you're holding something that belongs to my family.' Julian stares at the floor.

scenes.imagePrompt: Tight two-shot: DAMIAN shielding MARA with his shoulder; MARA's hand slipping into her coat pocket, thumb pressing a glowing phone screen with a small red recording light, her eyes locked defiantly forward.
scenes.videoPrompt: Damian steps in front of Mara. Behind his shoulder, her hand slips into her coat pocket and her thumb presses the phone screen; a tiny red recording light glows. Mara, steady, stepping half into view: 'It belongs to my father.'

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium close-up of VIVIENNE, cold fury cracking her composure, lit from below by the swinging bulb, one gloved finger raised; JULIAN in soft focus beside her, his head slowly turning to look at her in dawning horror.
scenes.videoPrompt: Vivienne's mask slips. Icy: 'Your father wouldn't stay quiet, so I silenced him. Give me the ledger.' Beside her, Julian freezes, slowly turning his head toward her.

scenes.imagePrompt: Close two-shot: JULIAN turning fully toward his mother, face crumbling with horror and betrayal, eyes wet; VIVIENNE rigid beside him, refusing to look at him.
scenes.videoPrompt: Julian turns to his mother, voice cracking: 'You told me it was an accident.' Vivienne, not looking at him, colder than ever: 'Don't be sentimental, Julian.' Julian shakes his head and takes a step back.

scenes.imagePrompt: Wide-medium shot: red and blue police light flooding through the cellar's high narrow window across VIVIENNE's stricken face and JULIAN's pale one; JULIAN stepping away from VIVIENNE with open hands; dust swirling in the colored light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Red and blue light sweeps across the brick walls as sirens swell. Vivienne freezes. Julian steps away from her, hands open: 'I'm done, Mother.' Vivienne, appalled: 'Julian, don't you dare.'

scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up on VIVIENNE, cornered and defiant, a brittle smile on her crimson lips, red-blue light flickering across her face, eyes flicking to someone off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cornered, Vivienne laughs, brittle and cold, and looks past Julian at someone off-screen: 'You think I started this? Read the last page.' The sirens grow louder.

scenes.imagePrompt: Over-the-shoulder shot of MARA flipping the ledger open to its final page under her flashlight; a bold ink signature at the bottom of the page; DAMIAN beside her reading, color draining from his face; red-blue light flickering on the brick walls.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara flips to the last page of the ledger as sirens wail above. Her eyes travel down to a bold signature at the bottom. She reads it aloud, hushed: 'Alistair Cross.' Beside her, Damian goes ghost-white: 'That's my grandfather.'

scenes.imagePrompt: Tight two-shot: MARA stepping back from DAMIAN, eyes wide with hurt and suspicion, the silver ring visible on her trembling hand; DAMIAN reaching for her, stricken; red-blue light strobing across both faces.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara backs away from Damian, the ledger clutched to her chest, the silver ring trembling on her hand. Broken: 'Did you know?' Damian, stricken, reaching for her: 'Mara, I swear...' She shakes her head. The sirens peak; cut to black.
